verdict.rationale: Claude Code documents scheduled runs ("Run Claude on a schedule to automate work that repeats: morning PR reviews, overnight CI failure analysis, weekly dependency audits") and event/trigger-based reactions via MCP channels pushing Telegram/Discord/webhook events into a session, plus CI integration and sandboxed autonomous Bash execution for safer unattended runs. However, this is framed as scheduled/triggered task execution rather than a persistent 'always-on agent' that continuously monitors and self-heals software with no evidence of long-running daemon/watchdog behavior, autonomous incident response loops, or independent hands-on confirmation of scheduling reliability. missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the scheduling feature actually working, evidence of continuous 24/7 monitoring/self-healing loops (not just periodic triggered tasks), and detail on failure recovery/persistence of these always-on agents.
